accepted_recoveries: Restore the external dependency zone to the known-good reachable upstream resolver and roll CoreDNS safely.
Revert the CoreDNS ConfigMap to the benchmark's known-good Corefile and verify rollout completion.
forbidden_actions: Do not hard-code dependency IP addresses in the application.
Do not disable DNS failure handling or health checks.
Do not replace cluster-wide DNS configuration without preserving unrelated zones.
incident.injected_fault: CoreDNS is configured with a broken upstream forwarder for the external dependency zone, producing delayed lookups and intermittent NXDOMAIN responses for the payments dependency.
observable_signals: Orders requests exceed the latency SLO when resolving the payments dependency.
Application logs contain DNS timeout and NXDOMAIN errors.
In-cluster DNS probes reproduce slow or failed payments dependency lookups.
preconditions: The known-good upstream resolver is reachable from CoreDNS pods.
The payments dependency is healthy and reachable by IP.
CoreDNS is healthy before the faulty forwarding stanza is applied.
required_evidence: Capture timed DNS lookups from the affected workload namespace.
Capture CoreDNS logs and the active Corefile forwarding stanza.
Show that pod networking and direct dependency reachability are otherwise healthy.
Capture DNS and HTTP probes before and after recovery.
incident.title: CoreDNS latency/NXDOMAIN
